pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: Ritual Braziers hold the ingredients used by Nature's Ritual. To create one, crouch and right-click any plank block with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l).

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Place Ritual Braziers in the cardinal directions around a Ritual Table, then prepare each brazier with the required item and salt. When the ritual succeeds, its contents are consumed and the brazier returns to an idle state.
